scope: Two fixed, label-free log-odds pooling comparisons on already trained compatible OOF predictions; no new training or weight search
validation: Exploratory aligned OOF5/42; no independent holdout and no public feedback
submission_rule: Select highest local OOF before public feedback; submit at most one candidate only if delta exceeds 0.0001 and at least four of five folds improve; otherwise retain the published solution.
